integrity: Full finite enumeration, graph-automorphism reduction, exact free-face collapses and integral lattice calculations are supplied in a standalone standard-library verifier. External independent audit is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite twelve-vertex truncated-tetrahedral graph; one edge deletion in either of two orbits; the primitive integral map is established at radius two, but homotopy maps between every scale are not determined. Bibliographic searches cannot prove priority.
title: Two single-edge Rips fault filtrations of the truncated tetrahedron and primitive integral survival
